claims.claim: A display-final period leaves the following phrase 'of length $n$.' as a sentence fragment.
claims.smallest_proposed_correction: Delete the period after $\mathfrak p_i \not = \mathfrak p_{i + 1}$ so the modifier continues after the display.

claims.claim: The adverb is misplaced in 'follows from directly the definitions'.
The opening phrase 'Reading back the reader' is malformed and leaves the object of reading unstated.
claims.smallest_proposed_correction: Use 'Reading the proof backwards, the reader will see that we proved the circular inequalities as desired.'
